mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing temperatures at 81 degrees under overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, with a current air quality index of 53, which is moderate.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K through 12, with submissions closing on July 22 and public voting set to run from July 28 through August 7. Also, please keep in mind the city policy regarding mailbox damage, which notes that property owners should ensure their mailboxes meet current postal specifications before the winter plowing season begins.

We have a busy schedule ahead with live music at Baileys Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Looking further ahead, mark your calendars for trivia nights starting on Monday at Hop Haus Brewing and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a look at our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a call where a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for O-W-I after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.

Treat yourself to the OREO Cookie Overload flavor of the day. Culvers is currently closed, but they will be opening their doors at 10 AM, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Snickers Swirl flavor.
